name: Moment-Damped Levenberg-Marquardt Optimizer
definition: A hybrid optimization strategy that partitions Gaussian parameters into geometry ($g \in \mathbb{R}^{10}$) and base appearance ($a \in \mathbb{R}^4$) blocks, solving them independently via small LM systems with Adam-style moment damping, while updating Higher-order SH coefficients separately with Adam.
summary: The Moment-Damped Levenberg-Marquardt Optimizer is a hybrid strategy for sparse-pixel training that partitions Gaussian parameters to solve small systems via Cholesky decomposition with Adam-style moment damping, distinguishing itself from gradient descent by using Hessian-informed updates.
